new_findings.scala: NewStoreQueue.scala:1299 releases the UnalignQueue entry on writeSbufferWire.head.fire; :1632 feeds the page hazard from unalignQueue.forwardEntries

new_findings.scala: NewStoreQueue.scala:1448 asserts NC never crosses 16B; :1071-1080 emits a single 8-byte mask; the NC path bypasses writeToSbuffer so the high half is never emitted
new_findings.reachability: cross16Byte is derived only from vaddr/size (NewStoreUnit.scala:200) and assigned directly to toSqAddr.cross16Byte (:449), independent of memory type; so NC crossing 16B is a producible LSQ input
new_findings.root_cause_relation: distinct from the 11 historical roots, from #6813 (cross-page second page) and from #6833 (uncache fault reporting / wline / synonym)
